title: Web Page "Page Types"
text:
## Web Page "Page Types"
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000000921
When editing a static page (or creating a new static page), the Page Info tab will show a dropdown of options for the "Page Type".
These are used to tell the system how the page should be handled (including how some functions and variables will be used).

## Single Web Page
This will tell the system that this page is a static page. Content-type pages can use images, call widgets, and more. This is the type that is most likely to be used.

## Password Retrieval Page
Every Brilliant Directories website will come with a default URL called /login/retrieval, where members can receive an email to update their password if they forget it. This option allows you to customize the elements on this page.

## Unsubscribe Page
Every Brilliant Directories website includes a default URL at /unsubscribed, where members and visitors can unsubscribe from the newsletter.
